questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Det var et nordisk land, så der var en relevans i forhold til mit dansk studie.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes det var forholdsvist nemt, men jeg var også opsøgende fra start og deltog i nogle informationskurser på universitetet, der forklarede om bl.a. deres bibliotek.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Det var ret meget op til en selv at tage kontakt, selvom man fik mails med information omkring diverse ting.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Generelt er det ligeså svært at finde bolig i Stockholm som det er i København, men jeg var ihærdig og gik i gang i god tid, så jeg havde allerede et sted at bo ca. 1,5 måned inden jeg tog afsted.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er klart der er sociale fordele ved at bo på campus, men ved ikke at gøre det, får man en meget bedre forståelse af byen, kulturen og de folk der bor der.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Jeg synes det var ret nemt at registrere mig til kurserne. Det var blevet gjort af min studievejleder på campus efter jeg havde tilmeldt mig dem.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Studievejlederne var ekstremt gode til at svare hurtigt og hjælpe os. Det var virkelig en kæmpe hjælp.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: jeg fik alle de fag jeg gerne ville have, så det var nemt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Spørg hvis du er i tvivl. Folk er virkelig hjælpsomme.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
Mit først kursus var stille og roligt. Den eneste udfordring var at der blev undervist på svensk, men det gik rigtig fint alligevel. 
Derudover var jeg også virkelig tilfreds med de sidste 2 fag. De udfordrede mig mere, og det var virkelig dejligt.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det var nogenlunde det samme. Der var ingen forlæsninger, men vi diskuterede altid det vi havde læst til undervisningen, hvilket er det samme som på KU.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Kulturkritik och kulturjournalistik, 
Swedish literature
Introduction to the field of performance studies.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: introduction to the field of performance studies, fordi underviseren var fantastisk.

Food DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Der var intet uventet, men jeg kan anbefale at have penge til ture og udflugter, da det godt kan koste lidt, hvis det skal være godt.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Maden var dyrere end forventet, specielt kød og grøntsager.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg deltog ikke selv i mange, men Stockholm Universitet er meget socialt og der er mange klubber og foreninger man kan melde sig ind i.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: De havde en stor sportsforening, hvor man kunne få undervisning af andre studerende. Derudover var der også klubber, der var naturvidenskabelige osv.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Meld dig ind i nogle af de klubber/unioner der er. Svenskerne kan være svære at komme ind på, men jeg tror virkelig unionerne gør noget godt i forhold til fællesskaab.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag ud i Skærgården eller til Kiruna.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt, eftersom Sverige minder om Danmark på mange punkter.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Gør et forsøg, men svenskerne er reserverede. De fleste af mine venner var derfor udvekslingsstuderende eller internationale.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Deres alkoholkultur. Det var ikke udfordrende, men jeg skulle helt sikkert tænke anderledes i forhold til hvis jeg skulle til fest eller andre sociale arrangementer.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Deres fika. Super hyggeligt og meget simpelt.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Være åben, udforsk byen og sig ja til arrangementer.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej ikke andet end at man skal være åben overfor andre og også svenskerne, selvom de ikke viser det samme igen.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Det at møde andre udvekslingsstudenter og finde ud af hvor godt vi har det i Danmark.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Nok det at skulle være social. Det kunne nogle gange være hårdt at hive sig selv med til arrangementer, når man helst ville være hjemme.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
